cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 75% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.49%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.15%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: WFRD is the standout at +7.32%
cards.body: Leaders: WFRD +7.32%, BE +7.10%, CEG +4.91%, TLN +4.86%, VST +4.64%. Laggards: ENPH -1.74%, LEU -1.56%, EOSE -1.49%, EQT -1.21%.
